items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: There was Roland Mayfield, when I was stranded at the age of 12 - I'd go out by myself a lot and he'd get in his car and pick me up and bring me home.

ctx.x: So you were getting real training?
Yes. Roland Mayfield later on - there were 3 important people in my life, including the pianist that I spoke about -
